evidence: LoadPlan0InVignet(resource_id) decodes a background of VIGNET.DAT (src/load.c:1008..). Its callers pass Plan0NumPcx[...] (load_world src/load.c:369, INIT_FND src/fnd.c:70, src/pcmain.c:730), which load_world fills from the shipped PCMAP/RAY1..6.WLD headers (pcx numbers XOR 0x15, src/load.c:230..236): the 40 ids 0..47 except 11,12,13,28..32 (parsed from the six world files). Destination buffers are the blocks the game allocates: DrawBufferNormal 64064 and EffetBufferNormal 128000 bytes (FIRST_INIT, src/cheat.c:347..348), PLAN0 from allocate_PLAN0(width*2, height) <= 768x289 (load_world, src/load.c:217..225).

file_layer.evidence: fopen/fread/fseek/ftell/fclose of the Watcom C library on the installed game data (models.FileLayer).

allocators.evidence: block_malloc(mem, size) / temp_malloc(size) return a new block of at least size bytes (game memory manager); modelled as fresh disjoint regions.

budget.evidence: one background (13..134 KB, byte-wise XOR loop, PCX decode into a 320x200..768x289 plane) per seed.
